_readme: Live demo map for fidelity.mjs (see README.md). Uses relative `file` paths (resolved against --project = this dir), so it is portable. Two keys: `shallow` = a self-anchor-only map (row + iconbox) that leaves the progress fill + icon unmeasured → the COVERAGE axis FAILs with 'insufficient coverage'. `full` = the same surface with no overrides → the engine auto-walks and catches the hidden fill/icon colour drift.
